# Check pca

```{r}
pca.in <- mpa %>%
  filter(grepl("s__", Taxonomy)) %>%
  select(Taxonomy, sample, RelAbun) %>%
  spread(key = Taxonomy, value = RelAbun) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample")

pca.in[is.na(pca.in)] <- 0

pca.out <- prcomp(pca.in, scale. = T)
plotdf <- pca.out$x %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

plotdf %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = sample)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text() +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/QC_quick-species-PCA.png")
```

# QC function

```{r}
QC_PCA_pruning <- function(prcomp.obj){
  
  # Grab necessary info from prcomp
  tmp <- prcomp.obj$x %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>%
    select(sample, PC1, PC2)
  
  # Find most dense point
  kdensity<- MASS::kde2d(x = tmp$PC1, y = tmp$PC2)
  maxcell <- which(kdensity$z == max(kdensity$z), arr.ind = T)
  maxx <- kdensity$x[maxcell[1,1]]
  maxy <- kdensity$y[maxcell[1,2]]
  
  # Calculate distance to center and report distance behavior
  tmp2 <- tmp %>%
    mutate(xdist = (maxx - PC1)^2,
           ydist = (maxy - PC2)^2,
           dist = sqrt(xdist + ydist))

  hist(tmp2$dist)
  boxplot(tmp2$dist)
  
  # Get IQR and use to determine QC pass/fail
  distsum <- summary(tmp2$dist)
  IQR <- (distsum[5] - distsum[2]) * 1.5
  min.dist = distsum[2] - IQR
  max.dist = distsum[5] + IQR
  
  tmp3 <- tmp2 %>%
    mutate(QCpass = ifelse(dist >= min.dist & dist <= max.dist, T,F)) %>%
    select(sample, QCpass)
  
  return(tmp3)
}
```

```{r}
test <- QC_PCA_pruning(pca.out)


table(test$QCpass)
```
